'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2021 Myanmar protests]]
**Ten officers are killed by an alliance of rebel groups during an attack at a [[police station]] in [[Naungmon]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/4/10/10-myanmar-police-killed-in-attack-by-ethnic-armies-reports (Al Jazeera)]
**Myanmar's [[Ambassador]] to the [[United Nations]] [[Kyaw Moe Tun]] calls for the international community to enforce a [[no-fly zone]] over his country to protect civilians from [[airstrike]]s, and to establish an [[arms embargo]] on the [[military junta|junta]], saying, "Your collective, strong action is needed immediately." [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/myanmars-un-envoy-urges-no-fly-zone-sanctions-against-junta (''The Straits Times'')]
*[[2021 Apure clashes]]
**The [[Venezuelan Armed Forces]] announce the arrest of an unspecified number of [[Sinaloa Cartel]] members amidst clashes with [[FARC dissidents]] in the state of [[Apure]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/4/10/venezuela-detains-sinaloa-cartel-members-in-clash-near-colombia (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**A [[suicide bomber]] targeting the [[Somalia|Somali]] [[Bay, Somalia|Bay]] [[administrative divisions of Somalia|region]]'s governor kills four people and wounds six others outside a bar in [[Baidoa]]. The governor escapes unharmed. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/africa/explosions-in-two-somalia-cities-kill-at-least-5/2021/04/10/37e3c5e8-9a04-11eb-8f0a-3384cf4fb399_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[Aftermath of the January 6 United States Capitol attack|Aftermath of the 2021 storming of the United States Capitol]]
**A previously undisclosed document provides new details regarding the [[January 6 United States Capitol attack|January 6 riot]] at the [[United States Capitol]]. The document shows that then-[[Vice President of the United States|Vice President]] [[Mike Pence]] made a call to the acting [[United States Secretary of Defense|Defense Secretary]] urging him to "clear the Capitol." Additionally, the document shows that [[Senate Majority Leader]] [[Chuck Schumer]] and [[Speaker of the United States House of Representatives|House Speaker]] [[Nancy Pelosi]] also made demands for the [[United States Army|Army]] to deploy the [[United States National Guard|National Guard]]. [https://apnews.com/article/capitol-siege-riots-michael-pence-nancy-pelosi-51924961afd065e8a600e9343a691463 (AP)] [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2021/apr/10/us-capitol-attack-mike-pence-pentagon (''The Guardian'')]
*Four people are killed and four more are wounded after security forces open fire on protesters during election-related violence in [[West Bengal]], [[India]]. Another person is killed when unknown gunmen fire at voters at a [[polling booth]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/4/10/5-killed-in-local-election-violence-in-indias-west-bengal-state (Al Jazeera)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Anti Monopoly Law of China]]
**[[China]]'s [[State Administration for Market Regulation]] issues a {{CNY|link=yes|18.2 billion}} ([[United States dollar|$]]2.78 billion) fine against [[technology company]] [[Alibaba Group|Alibaba]] over [[anti-competitive practices]] which forced merchants to choose one of two platforms, rather than being able to work with both. [https://www.cnbc.com/2021/04/09/china-fines-alibaba-in-anti-monopoly-probe.html (CNBC)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021 East Java earthquake]]
**An [[earthquake]] kills at least seven people and damages buildings in [[Java]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/4/10/deadly-earthquake-rocks-indonesias-java-no-tsunami-warning (Al Jazeera)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in India]]
*****[[India]] becomes the fastest country in the world to administer 100 million doses of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/coronavirus-vaccinations-cross-10-crore-doses-despite-the-recent-dip/article34291633.ece (''The Hindu'')]
****[[India]] reports a record 145,384 new confirmed cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 13.2 million. [https://m.timesofindia.com/india/india-reports-145384-new-covid-cases-highest-one-day-surge/amp_articleshow/81999440.cms  (''The Times of India'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bangladesh]]
****[[Bangladesh]] reports a record 77 deaths in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 9,661. [https://bdnews24.com/coronavirus-pandemic/2021/04/10/bangladesh-reports-77-new-virus-deaths-a-daily-record-cases-rise-by-5343 (Bdnews24.com)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]] imposes a 10-day [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] in 23 of 31 [[Provinces of Iran|province]]s in order to reduce the spread of COVID-19 amid a fourth wave of the pandemic. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/1840641/middle-east (Arab News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Andorra]]
****Speaker of the [[General Council (Andorra)|General Council]] [[Roser Suñé Pascuet|Roser Suñé]] receives the first shot of the AstraZeneca vaccine. [https://www.diariandorra.ad/noticies/nacional/2021/04/10/josep_maria_rossell_segon_ministre_que_vacuna_covid_177950_1125.html (''Diari d'Andorra'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Romania]]
****[[Romania]] surpasses one million cases of COVID-19. [https://www.nydailynews.com/coronavirus/ny-covid-romania-surpasses-one-million-cases-20210410-2zkarjxnofahbhcvsuyr5bwn5e-story.html (''The New York Daily News'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Toronto]]
*****[[Mayor of Toronto|Toronto Mayor]] [[John Tory]] receives his first dose of the [[AstraZeneca]] [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]. [https://toronto.ctvnews.ca/toronto-mayor-john-tory-receives-first-dose-of-astrazeneca-covid-19-vaccine-1.5382346 (CTV News)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ottawa]]
*****[[Ottawa]] reports a record 325 new confirmed cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/ottawa/covid19-ottawa-cases-numbers-trends-april-10-1.5982763 (CBC)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Libya]]
***[[Libya]] begins a [[vaccination]] campaign against COVID-19, with [[Prime Minister of Libya|Prime Minister]] [[Abdul Hamid Dbeibeh]] receiving his first dose of the COVID-19 vaccine. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/4/10/libya-launches-covid-19-vaccination-drive-after-delays (Al Jazeera)]
**[[COVID-19 vaccine]]
***[[Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention]] director [[Gao Fu]] admits at a conference in [[Chengdu]] that the vaccines developed by China "don't have very high protection rates", and that the government is considering mixing them to provide the protection needed. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/4/11/chinese-vaccines-effectiveness-low-official-admits (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Capital punishment in Saudi Arabia]]
**[[Saudi Arabia]] [[capital punishment|executes]] three [[Armed Forces of Saudi Arabia|soldiers]] for "high [[treason]]" and "cooperating with the enemy" in [[Najran Province]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-saudi-security/saudi-arabia-executes-three-soldiers-sentenced-for-high-treason-idUSKBN2BX07P?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[2021 Northern Ireland riots]]
**[[Police Service of Northern Ireland|Police]] say that overnight clashes resulted in fourteen officers injured in [[Belfast]] and [[Coleraine]]. The violence also saw a burning car used to ram a police vehicle, trash bins [[arson|set on fire]], and three 14-year-old children arrested. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-northern-ireland-56699716 (BBC News)]
*[[Terrorism in the United States]]
**The [[Federal Bureau of Investigation|FBI]] charges a 28-year-old man with attempting to blow up an [[Amazon (company)|Amazon]] [[data center]] as part of a plot to disable the [[Internet]] and to specifically impede the activities of United States federal bodies. They also claim that he said he was involved in the [[2021 storming of the United States Capitol|storming]] of the [[United States Capitol|U.S. Capitol building]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/crime/capitol-rioter-bomb-amazon-fbi-b1829588.html (''The Independent'')]
*[[2021 Rock Hill shooting]]
**The sole survivor of a [[mass shooting]] in [[Rock Hill, South Carolina]], that killed five others three days earlier has died from his gunshot wounds, according to the local coroner. [https://apnews.com/article/nfl-rock-hill-phillip-adams-football-shootings-3a1bab9f276c57c5cb81255d2ba540dd (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Djiboutian presidential election]]
**Incumbent President [[Ismail Omar Guelleh]] wins a landslide victory securing over 97% of the votes cast, in an election boycotted by the opposition. The leader of the opposition says that the results are "far from reality". Guelleh will serve his fifth consecutive term. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-djibouti-election/djiboutis-president-guelleh-wins-fifth-term-with-97-of-votes-idUSKBN2BX0IQ?il=0 (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Nuclear program of Iran]]
**[[President of Iran|Iranian President]] [[Hassan Rouhani]] inaugurates a series of advanced [[Enriched uranium|uranium enrichment]] [[Gas centrifuge|centrifuges]] at the [[Natanz#Nuclear facility|Natanz nuclear facility]], revealing that [[Iran]] had violated in kind the [[Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action]] which mandates the testing and usage of only "first-generation" centrifuges for uranium enrichment, in response to Western sanctions violating the deal. The move comes amid indirect discussions in [[Vienna]] between Iran and the United States to revive the deal. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/middle-east/iran-starts-up-advanced-centrifuges-in-nuclear-deal-breach (''The Straits Times'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[2021 Grand National]]
**[[Irish people|Irish]] [[jockey]] [[Rachael Blackmore]] becomes the first female winner of the [[Grand National]]. Another horse, The Grand Mile, suffers a broken leg and is [[euthanasia|euthanised]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/horse-racing/56701659 (BBC News)] [https://www.manchestereveningnews.co.uk/news/uk-news/grand-national-horse-dies-following-20361743 (''The Manchester Evening News'')]
